penalty_layers.component: Standalone PRC or U.S. 'Currency Conversion Tax' / 'Exit Tax'
penalty_layers.who_pays_and_when: Neither China nor the United States imposes an excise or exit tax on the act of exchanging CNY into USD. State Council Decree 532 Art. 5 guarantees no restriction on bona fide current-account international payments.
penalty_layers.how_to_minimize_legally: Demand the bank's refusal or 'tax' explanation in writing so you separate a free tax-certificate requirement from an actual unpaid income tax.

penalty_layers.component: PRC Underlying Income / Gain Tax & SAFE Tax-Voucher Gatekeeper
penalty_layers.verified_rate_or_amount: 0% extra if already taxed; otherwise 3%–45% comprehensive IIT (after RMB 60,000/yr deduction), 5%–35% business IIT, 20% statutory flat IIT (10% U.S.–China Treaty cap on dividends/interest/royalties); 25% corporate EIT
penalty_layers.who_pays_and_when: Owed when the PRC income arose — NOT triggered by wiring. However, SAFE (Hui Fa [2020] No. 14 Art. 59) requires STA tax vouchers (完税证明 / 纳税记录) before converting foreign-individual RMB income, and STA/SAFE Announcement [2013] No. 40 + [2021] No. 19 require a FREE online Tax Recordal Form (税务备案表) for domestic-payer outbound payments > USD 50,000.
penalty_layers.how_to_minimize_legally: 1) If employer already withheld IIT, download 个人所得税纳税记录 from the IIT App for $0 extra tax. 2) Claim 10% U.S.–China Treaty caps (Arts. 9, 10, 11) and check Art. 13/14 183-day / Art. 19 3-yr teacher exemptions. 3) Use free Electronic Tax Bureau filing for > $50,000 Tax Recordal.

penalty_layers.component: U.S. Worldwide Income Tax Interaction (Foreign Tax Credit vs. FEIE)
penalty_layers.verified_rate_or_amount: Dollar-for-dollar Foreign Tax Credit (Form 1116) OR up to $132,900 Foreign Earned Income Exclusion (2026 Form 2555)
penalty_layers.who_pays_and_when: U.S. citizens are taxed on worldwide income when earned (Protocol 1 Para. 2 Saving Clause), whether stuck in China or wired home. Repatriating principal is NOT a second U.S. income event.
penalty_layers.how_to_minimize_legally: Claim Form 1116 Foreign Tax Credit for creditable PRC income taxes paid (up to 10-year refund amendment window under IRC § 6511(d)(3)(A)!). Always claim the 10% U.S.–China Treaty rate in China when eligible, because the IRS disallows FTC for voluntary overpayment above a treaty rate! Never claim FTC on income already excluded via Form 2555.

penalty_layers.component: U.S. Foreign Currency Exchange Gain on Converting RMB→USD (26 U.S.C. § 988(e))
penalty_layers.verified_rate_or_amount: $0 if exchange gain <= $200 per personal transaction (or if RMB depreciated vs. USD basis); Capital Gain if personal exchange gain > $200; Ordinary Income/Loss if business/trade
penalty_layers.who_pays_and_when: Triggered upon disposing of RMB for USD if the USD value at conversion exceeds your historical USD functional-currency basis in that RMB by more than $200 (personal FX losses are non-deductible).
penalty_layers.how_to_minimize_legally: Track exact historical USD acquisition basis for each RMB deposit tranche (e.g., IRS spot/yearly-average rates: 6.452 in 2021, 6.730 in 2022, 7.075 in 2023, 7.189 in 2024, 7.129 in 2025). Tranches acquired when RMB was stronger (e.g., 2021–2022 at 6.45–6.73) have an FX loss at ~7.13, meaning $0 U.S. § 988(e) gain!

penalty_layers.component: Bank CNY→USD Bid-Ask FX Spread (Hidden Commercial Friction)
penalty_layers.verified_rate_or_amount: — (Unverified in official/static sources; quoted live at execution)
penalty_layers.who_pays_and_when: Embedded in the difference between interbank mid-market CNY/USD and the bank's telegraphic-transfer selling rate (现汇卖出价) or cash selling rate (现钞卖出价) at execution.
penalty_layers.how_to_minimize_legally: Always convert via Telegraphic Transfer exchange rate (现汇), not Cash/Banknote rate (现钞); compare your PRC bank's live spot selling quote against Wise From-CNY (if eligible) and ask relationship managers about tier FX spread discounts on large ($100k–$400k) tickets.

penalty_layers.component: Outward Wire Commission, SWIFT Cable, Intermediary Lifting & U.S. Receiving Fees
penalty_layers.verified_rate_or_amount: HSBC China published sender fee: $0.00 (Private Banking / Premier Elite individuals); 0.1% min CNY 100 max CNY 500 + CNY 120 cable = $30.86–$86.97 (Premier/Advance SHA at 7.129); +CNY 200 ($28.05) optional Pay Exact (OUR); Global Transfer to Self: $0.00 (PB/Premier) or $20.00 (Advance). Third-party correspondent/receiving fees: — (unverified).
penalty_layers.who_pays_and_when: Charged per wire transaction. Because HSBC's 0.1% commission caps at CNY 500 above CNY 500,000 (~$70,136), wiring in 1 documented lump sum ($86.97) costs 6x less in sender fees than splitting into 8 annual $50k wires ($534.66).
penalty_layers.how_to_minimize_legally: Remit in a single documented M01 lump sum rather than many small wires, or use HSBC Premier Global Transfer ($0 published transfer fee) if holding linked own-name HSBC China + HSBC U.S. accounts.

penalty_layers.component: Offshore Non-Reporting & Illegal FX Channel Penalties (Where Catastrophic Losses Happen)
penalty_layers.verified_rate_or_amount: U.S. FBAR: up to $16,536 non-willful / max($165,353, 50% of balance) willful; Form 8938: $10,000–$60,000 + 40% understatement; Form 3520 gift/bequest: 5%/mo up to 25%; FinCEN 105 cash: seizure/forfeiture. PRC illegal FX/crypto/splitting/underground bank: up to 30% fine (30%–100% if serious) + criminal liability.
penalty_layers.who_pays_and_when: U.S. reporting obligations attach while the RMB sits in China (even before converting a single yuan!). PRC 30%–100% fines attach when attempting quota-splitting, underground swaps, fake invoices, or crypto bridges.
penalty_layers.how_to_minimize_legally: File timely FBARs & Form 8938 every year; if delinquent due to non-willful mistake and not under IRS exam, evaluate IRS Streamlined Foreign Offshore (0% penalty) or Streamlined Domestic Offshore (5% penalty) with a U.S. cross-border tax attorney/CPA BEFORE wiring.

tax_compliance_rows.item: Comprehensive Income IIT (Resident >= 183 days: Wages, Services, Author, Royalties)
tax_compliance_rows.threshold_or_scope: Annual taxable income after RMB 60,000 standard deduction + statutory special deductions
tax_compliance_rows.action_for_us_citizen: Download 个人所得税纳税记录 from IIT App to unlock bank conversion M01; claim U.S. Form 1116 FTC (or Form 2555 FEIE on earned wages).

tax_compliance_rows.item: Business Operation IIT (个体工商户 / Sole Proprietorship / Operating Income)
tax_compliance_rows.action_for_us_citizen: Clear operating IIT + VAT to obtain STA tax vouchers; note business FX does not get U.S. § 988(e) $200 exclusion.

tax_compliance_rows.item: Dividends, Interest & Royalties Derived from China by U.S. Resident Beneficial Owner
tax_compliance_rows.threshold_or_scope: PRC statutory IIT is 20% flat; 1984 U.S.–China Tax Treaty Arts. 9(2), 10(2), 11(2) cap beneficial-owner withholding
tax_compliance_rows.action_for_us_citizen: MUST claim the 10% treaty rate in China — IRS Foreign Tax Credit rules disallow crediting voluntary excess withholding above the 10% treaty cap!

tax_compliance_rows.item: Property Lease & Property / Equity Transfer Gain IIT
tax_compliance_rows.threshold_or_scope: Net gain on transfer of PRC real property or equity; statutory lease income
tax_compliance_rows.verified_rate_or_penalty: 20% flat statutory IIT (PRC may tax China real property & >=25% equity gains under Treaty Arts. 6 & 12)
tax_compliance_rows.action_for_us_citizen: Obtain 房屋权属转让完税证明 + >$50k free Tax Recordal to wire sale proceeds under M09; claim PRC income tax on Form 1116.

tax_compliance_rows.item: STA & SAFE Outbound Payment Tax Recordal (服务贸易等项目对外支付税务备案表)
tax_compliance_rows.threshold_or_scope: Single outbound payment > USD 50,000 by domestic institutions/individuals for remuneration, dividends, property/equity sale proceeds, or service trade
tax_compliance_rows.verified_rate_or_penalty: $0 filing fee (instant/online via Electronic Tax Bureau; filed once per contract under [2021] No. 19)
tax_compliance_rows.action_for_us_citizen: Not a tax! Administrative recordal only — obtain serial number & verification code online to hand to the remitting bank.

tax_compliance_rows.item: Foreign Tax Credit (Form 1116) vs. Foreign Earned Income Exclusion (Form 2555)
tax_compliance_rows.threshold_or_scope: Worldwide income of U.S. citizens; 2026 FEIE max = $132,900 (tax home + bona fide residence or 330-day physical presence)
tax_compliance_rows.verified_rate_or_penalty: Dollar-for-dollar FTC credit (10-yr refund claim period) OR up to $132,900 earned-income exclusion
tax_compliance_rows.action_for_us_citizen: Because PRC marginal IIT on higher salaries (20%–45%) often equals/exceeds U.S. effective rates, Form 1116 FTC frequently reduces residual U.S. tax on China salary to $0 while generating excess FTC carryforwards (cannot combine FTC + FEIE on the same dollar).

tax_compliance_rows.item: Personal Foreign Currency Exchange Gain (26 U.S.C. § 988(e)(2) & IRS Pub. 525)
tax_compliance_rows.threshold_or_scope: Disposition of nonfunctional currency (CNY→USD) in a personal transaction
tax_compliance_rows.verified_rate_or_penalty: $0 tax if FX gain <= $200/transaction; Capital Gain (Schedule D) if FX gain > $200 (personal FX losses non-deductible)
tax_compliance_rows.action_for_us_citizen: Compute USD basis of each RMB deposit using spot/consistent posted rate when acquired vs. USD received at conversion.

tax_compliance_rows.item: FBAR — FinCEN Form 114 (Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts)
tax_compliance_rows.threshold_or_scope: Aggregate value of all foreign financial accounts > $10,000 at ANY time during the calendar year (due April 15, auto-extended to Oct 15)
tax_compliance_rows.verified_rate_or_penalty: Max civil penalty (assessed >= 2025-01-17): $16,536 non-willful; max($165,353, 50% of account) willful + criminal exposure
tax_compliance_rows.action_for_us_citizen: Every $10,000–$400,000 tier in this study (above $10,000.00 aggregate) triggers mandatory annual e-filing via FinCEN BSA E-Filing.

tax_compliance_rows.item: Form 8938 — Statement of Specified Foreign Financial Assets
tax_compliance_rows.threshold_or_scope: Living in U.S.: >$50k yr-end / >$75k any time (Single), >$100k / >$150k (MFJ). Living abroad: >$200k yr-end / >$300k any time (Single), >$400k / >$600k (MFJ)
tax_compliance_rows.verified_rate_or_penalty: $10,000 failure-to-disclose + $10,000 per 30 days after IRS notice (up to $60,000 total) + 40% § 6662(j) understatement penalty
tax_compliance_rows.action_for_us_citizen: Attach Form 8938 to Form 1040 IN ADDITION to filing FinCEN Form 114 (filing one never excuses the other).

tax_compliance_rows.item: Form 3520 — Foreign Gifts / Inheritances (IRC § 6039F) & Foreign Trusts (IRC § 6677)
tax_compliance_rows.threshold_or_scope: > $100,000 aggregate gifts or bequests received in a tax year from a nonresident alien individual or foreign estate
tax_compliance_rows.verified_rate_or_penalty: Foreign gift/bequest: 5% per month up to 25% of unreported gift/bequest; Foreign trust distribution: max($10,000, 35%)
tax_compliance_rows.action_for_us_citizen: Crucial for M10 (Mainland inheritance > $100k) or gifts from non-U.S. Chinese relatives: bequest is tax-free, but missing Form 3520 costs up to 25%!

tax_compliance_rows.item: FinCEN Form 105 (CMIR) — Cross-Border Physical Currency / Monetary Instruments
tax_compliance_rows.threshold_or_scope: > $10,000 total currency/monetary instruments carried into or out of the U.S. (applies collectively to families/groups traveling together)
tax_compliance_rows.verified_rate_or_penalty: $0 tax/fee if declared; civil seizure & forfeiture + criminal penalties if undeclared
tax_compliance_rows.action_for_us_citizen: File electronically at fincen105.cbp.dhs.gov before arrival whenever collective cash exceeds $10,000.

tax_compliance_rows.item: Streamlined Filing Compliance Procedures (SFOP vs. SDOP)
tax_compliance_rows.threshold_or_scope: Individual taxpayers whose prior failure to report foreign accounts/income was non-willful and who are NOT under IRS civil examination or CI investigation (3 yrs returns + 6 yrs FBARs)
tax_compliance_rows.verified_rate_or_penalty: 0% offshore penalty (Streamlined Foreign Offshore — met 330-day non-U.S.-abode test in >=1 of last 3 yrs) vs. 5% Title 26 penalty (Streamlined Domestic Offshore — U.S. residents)
tax_compliance_rows.action_for_us_citizen: If the China account was previously unreported, consult qualified U.S. tax counsel to evaluate SFOP (0%) or SDOP (5%) BEFORE initiating a large wire into a U.S. bank.
